title: Notice of Medicare Non-Coverage and the End of Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage
content:
**Rule.** When skilled services end while Part A days remain, coverage ends only through a Notice of Medicare Non-Coverage. Skilled services end when the resident no longer needs skilled nursing on the skilled nursing days per week minimum, or skilled rehabilitation on the skilled rehab days per week minimum when rehabilitation is the only skilled service. The NOMNC is delivered at least the NOMNC lead days before the last covered date, counting calendar days with the delivery date as day 0; a notice delivered later moves the last covered date to the NOMNC lead days after the delivery date, and the center, not the resident, bears the days in between. No NOMNC is required when coverage ends because the benefit-period day limit is reached (benefit days exhausted), when the resident chooses to leave the center (discharged from center), when a hospital transfer is not followed by a return within the interrupted-stay window (hospital transfer, no return) or on the resident's death (resident deceased); those endings post directly from active. A notice whose last covered date passes without a timely appeal ends coverage with the end reason "skilled need ended". After Part A days are used up, medically necessary therapy may continue under Medicare Part B as a separate therapy plan of care.

This compliance memorandum covers how Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage ends.

### Endings

| Ending | NOMNC required |
|---|---|
| Skilled services end while Part A days remain | Yes |
| Benefit-period day limit reached | No |
| Resident chooses to leave the center | No |
| Hospital transfer without return within the interrupted-stay window | No |
| Resident's death | No |

### Lead-day count on hypothetical dates (lead of 2 days from the schedule)

| NOMNC delivered on | Planned last covered date | Result |
|---|---|---|
| The 25th | The 27th | Timely — the 27th is day 2 |
| The 26th | The 27th | Late — the last covered date moves to the 28th; the center bears the 28th |
